job._mode: Pretraining from scratch. Set resume_from to a checkpoint path to continue a previous run.
job._training: Training hyperparameters. accumulation_steps=10 simulates a batch of 10*batch_size=10000 subgraphs per optimizer step. sample_every=5 generates n_samples=1000 molecules every 5 epochs to track NLL and UC-JSD convergence.
job._architecture: Larger architecture than the debug default, appropriate for ChEMBL-scale pretraining. hidden_node_features=256, message_passes=4 gives more expressive representations over ChEMBL's diverse chemistry.
